verdict.rationale: Docs claim you can 'build AI agents and integrations powered by the same core engine' behind Cline's CLI/Kanban/extensions, suggesting some SDK-like access, but there's no actual SDK reference, API docs, or code samples — and the openapi probe found no published API spec (404s across all candidate paths). Missing for 10: concrete SDK/API reference documentation, code examples, published API spec, and independent/community corroboration of building against it.
